summary.text: Mark Sanford is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 17 since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sanford earned a B.S. in math and history from Minot State University, according to Ballotpedia, and later earned an M.Ed. in school administration and an Ed.D. from the University of North Dakota.
His professional experience includes working as a school administrator before retiring.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Appropriations - Education and Environment Committee.
